author: allnes
title: Android CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked as static targets
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build x64
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure fails with MODULE_LIBRARY target_link_libraries errors for all plugins

failed_jobs.name: Build arm64
failed_jobs.symptom: Same CMake configure failure on arm64 build

key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_auto_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target.  One may link only to INTERFACE, OBJECT, STATIC or SHARED libraries, or to executables with the ENABLE_EXPORTS property set.
CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_intel_cpu_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target.
root_cause: The `ov_target_link_plugins` function in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 tries to link MODULE_LIBRARY plugin targets into another target. This is only safe when BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF (static build), where the function is expected to be a no-op (early return). The Android build uses BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON, which should trigger the early return, but somehow the function is running and hitting the link errors. This PR (#37211) only modifies GPU plugin C++ source files and `.clang-tidy`, which should not affect CMake configuration. The failure may indicate a pre-existing or unrelated issue in the Android workflow, or the merge queue combined this PR with another commit that changed CMake logic.
reproduction_steps: N/A - Android build requires the Android NDK Docker container and cannot be easily reproduced locally
recommended_actions: Check whether the merge queue combined this PR with another commit that modified cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake or BUILD_SHARED_LIBS logic
Verify the Android build container image (ubuntu_22_04_android:pr-37010) has correct CMake version compatibility
Check if cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:261 BUILD_SHARED_LIBS guard is being evaluated correctly for the Android x64/arm64 builds
prevention_strategies: For CMake changes affecting plugin linking behavior, ensure Android CI is included in presubmit checks. GPU-only style PRs should not affect CMake configure.
historical_context: No prior instances of this exact CMake Android plugin linking failure found in the database.
